icae.abs: This research focuses on quantum error-correcting codes (QECCs) that exist and are defined as a unitary mapping (encoding) of qubits into a subspace of the quantum state space. The encoding maps k qubits into a 2-qubit quantum state system, and if any t of the qubits undergo arbitrary decoherence, the remaining n-qubits can be used to faithfully reconstruct the original quantum state. The research shows that asymptotic rate k/n = 1/2 for these codes, with an upper bound on the asymptotic rate.
